test_title: SSC Stenographer 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: What is the meaning of the word "spendthrift"?

options.text: A person who invests money wisely

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. "person who spends money recklessly". [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"spendthrift"** refers to a person who spends money in an extravagant or reckless manner. (अपव्ययी) • **Example:** Despite earning a good salary, John was a spendthrift and often ended up borrowing money by the end of the month. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 2: A person who invests money wisely** (बुद्धिमानी से पैसा निवेश करने वाला व्यक्ति): Refers to someone who carefully evaluates opportunities to grow their money through investments. • **Example:** Sarah is a wise investor who researches thoroughly before buying stocks. • **Option 3: A person who saves money** (पैसा बचाने वाला व्यक्ति): Refers to someone who is cautious about their spending habits and focuses on accumulating savings. • **Example:** Jack is a saver who prefers to deposit his money in fixed deposit accounts. • **Option 4: A person who borrows money** (पैसा उधार लेने वाला व्यक्ति): Refers to someone who takes loans or borrows money from others to meet their financial needs. • **Example:** Due to financial difficulties, Peter had to borrow money from his friends. 173:Ta2f, The correct answer is: **Option 4 (Exonerated)**.
